title: AutoTerm-SST: Adaptive Terminology Memory with Zero Session-Time Setup for Streaming Speech Translation
abstract: arXiv:2610.26865v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented speech translation improves rare terminology, but systems such as RASST still assume that users provide a glossary before each session. That assumption is inconvenient for live talks, while merging every domain into one growing glossary eventually places too many irrelevant terms in the same retrieval and prompt competition. We present AutoTerm-SST, an interactive system that removes session-time glossary upload and domain selection. It organizes a large offline terminology catalog into topic slices, matches recent streaming translation context to bilingual slice prototypes, and activates a compact multi-slice working set under fixed retrieval and prompt budgets. On five ACL and five ESO oncology talks, AutoTerm matches a known-domain reference in terminology accuracy (88.3% vs. 88.1%) and mWER-resegmented BLEU (45.09 vs. 45.19), while requiring no domain input. translated_title: AutoTerm-SST：面向流式语音翻译的零会话时设置自适应术语记忆
translated_abstract: 检索增强语音翻译能够改善稀有术语的翻译，但诸如RASST等系统仍然假设用户在每次会话开始前提供术语表。这一假设对于现场演讲来说并不方便，而将所有领域合并到一个不断增长的术语表中，最终会导致过多的无关术语出现在同一检索和提示竞争之中。我们提出AutoTerm-SST，这是一个消除了会话时术语表上传和领域选择需求的交互式系统。该系统将大型离线术语目录组织成主题切片，将最近的流式翻译上下文与双语切片原型进行匹配，并在固定的检索和提示预算下激活一个紧凑的多切片工作集。在五场ACL和五场ESO肿瘤学演讲上，AutoTerm在术语准确率（88.3% vs. 88.1%）和mWER重新分词BLEU分数（45.09 vs. 45.19）方面与已知领域的参考系统相当，同时无需任何领域输入。与一个包含一百万条目的合并术语表相比，它…（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: AutoTerm-SST提出了一种无需会话时上传术语表和选择领域的自适应术语记忆系统，通过将离线术语目录组织为主题切片并根据流式翻译上下文动态激活相关切片，在肿瘤学演讲翻译中实现了与已知领域设置相当的术语准确率。
en_tdlr: AutoTerm-SST introduces an adaptive terminology memory system that removes session-time glossary upload and domain selection by organizing offline terminology catalogs into topic slices and dynamically activating relevant slices based on streaming translation context, achieving terminology accuracy comparable to known-domain settings on oncology talks.
